location: p. 238 (PDF p. 4), Data Analysis and Results (Behavioural Data)
quote: Another dog only had behavioural data for the owner crying … condition because of a camera malfunction. This left behavioural … data for 14 dogs who had data in all heart rate conditions and 15 … dogs with full data in behavioural coding.
reason: Although 16 dog-owner pairs were recruited, one dog was missing behavioural data in all conditions except owner crying due to a camera malfunction, leaving an analytic sample of 15 dogs for the repeated-measures behavioural ANOVA (confirmed by the familiarity main effect F(1, 14) and interaction F(2, 28) error degrees of freedom).
